packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to a digest (short SHA + version comment).
Mathlib4 tags weekly. Keep these on the dependency dashboard for human ack rather than auto-opening a PR (and a ~30-60 min/arch base rebuild) every week.
Group the Lean4 toolchain + Mathlib bumps so a coordinated base move lands as one reviewable PR.

Isabelle base has TWO `ubuntu` FROMs (a stable heap-builder base + a CVE-patched runtime base). The built-in dockerfile manager would bump both to the same digest, re-invalidating the cached 90-150 min CBO bake on every CVE refresh. Disable it here; the runtime base is bumped by the marked customManager below, and the heap-builder base is pinned (bumped manually on Isabelle/AFP/major-OS changes).

customManagers.description: Z3 solver version pin in tools/z3.Dockerfile. Upstream tags ship as `z3-X.Y.Z`; extractVersion strips the `z3-` prefix so the ARG stays in bare semver form.
cvc5 SMT solver version pin in tools/cvc5.Dockerfile. Upstream tags ship as `cvc5-X.Y.Z`; extractVersion strips the `cvc5-` prefix.
Apalache TLA+ model checker version pin in tools/apalache.Dockerfile. Upstream tags ship as `vX.Y.Z`; extractVersion strips the `v` prefix.
Yices2 SMT solver version pin in tools/yices2.Dockerfile. Upstream tags ship as `Yices-X.Y.Z`; extractVersion strips the `Yices-` prefix.
dReal4 delta-complete SMT solver version pin in tools/dreal.Dockerfile. Upstream uses non-semver date-style tags (e.g. `4.21.06.2`) so `versioning: loose` is required.

Lean4 toolchain pin in tools/lean4-base.Dockerfile (`leanprover/lean4:vX.Y.Z` form). The `leanprover/lean4:` prefix is preserved by autoReplaceStringTemplate so the ARG retains its full elan-compatible form.
Mathlib4 git revision pin in tools/lean4-base.Dockerfile. Tracks `leanprover-community/mathlib4` tags. Gated to the dependency dashboard by the matching packageRule (Mathlib tags weekly).

Isabelle base RUNTIME ubuntu digest only (CVE patches). Targets the FROM tagged `# renovate-runtime-base ubuntu` in tools/isabelle-base.Dockerfile; the heap-builder base FROM is intentionally left untracked so a routine runtime CVE bump does not re-run the cached CBO bake. The built-in dockerfile manager is disabled for this file via packageRules.
